rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A sentence saying how you'd know points at the outcome, not the nearest artifact.

The one 'tells you' clause in body, line 59 'this is the gauge that tells you when steering is becoming harder', points CRAP/complexity metrics (an externally-computed signal) at an outward, independently-checkable system state (steering difficulty) rather than having the metric certify its own soundness — not the self-witnessing shape (a read judging the context it was read from) the rule targets. What would have to be observed for this to be false: steering staying easy while the metric worsens, or vice versa — a real, external falsification condition, not the instrument grading itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Say it once, at its most concrete, then at most one sentence that generalises it. Style, not a gate.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Newly added rule (not present in the prior instance for this file — confirmed by its absence from the prior recorded ledger's check_writing entries, which stopped at §26). Closest candidate: each of the nine `##` sections opens or closes its paragraph with a sentence that echoes its own header in near-verbatim language (e.g. header 45 'Unit tests shrink the agent's room to improvise' vs closing line 47 'the agent has more room to improvise'; header 65 'Architecture needs an instrument panel too' vs line 67 'it needs instruments'; header 75 '...moves up, it doesn't vanish' vs line 83 '...moves toward the work of deciding...'). Read against the rule's own worked example (two sentences saying the same claim at different altitudes with nothing new added between them), this pattern differs: the sentence BETWEEN the header-echo bookends carries the actual new mechanism or contrast in every section (line 47's middle sentences name the concrete tripwire mechanism; line 67 adds a new ownership claim the header didn't state; line 77-81 add the mental-model question list), so the echo is a closing/opening callback naming what the paragraph already earned, not a second full restatement of the argument with zero information added. The device is applied identically and consistently across all nine sections, which reads as the essay's deliberate structural scaffolding (header previews the thesis, paragraph proves it, closing line returns to it) rather than an unintended machine-cadence artifact a generation-time cut would have caught. Flagging all nine would ask for a restructure of the piece's whole rhetorical shape on a rule that names itself 'style, not a gate' and 'not a REVISE on its own.'
